stackDivergence.rationale: Existing browser package APIs return JS XML strings. This boundary constructs actual native input values and decodes actual stream-produced UTF8 only; encoding, validation and SAX state are exclusively source services.

preservedResponsibilities: Existing browser package APIs return JS XML strings. This boundary constructs actual native input values and decodes actual stream-produced UTF8 only; encoding, validation and SAX state are exclusively source services.

OFOP WriteRelationsInfoSequence and WriteContentSequence now consume actual XOutputStream/context/native StringPair sequences and registered source Writer. Attribute admission and failure occur in original order after root callbacks. Actual ManifestWriter implements the original XManifestWriter/XServiceInfo component, acquired context, exact package2 registration, native PropertyValue sequences and original SAXException-to-WrappedTargetRuntimeException wrapping with empty outer Message/Context. ManifestExport consumes the actual XDocumentHandler reference/native nested sequences and queries the original extended facet after startDocument. The duplicate XmlStringDocumentHandler encoder and five-callback alias are removed. Existing package string boundaries only bind actual native containers/stream bytes; no replacement XML encoder, fake provider or lazy core bootstrap exists. Dedicated Worker entrypoints own realm-local services; test fixtures initialize the same actual registry. Plain unencrypted OASIS admission remains bounded; legacy/encryption, full Sfx metadata/storage and final DOCX/XLSX core/shell/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Native physical ABI/allocator/debug/binary/timing parity is unqualified; previous coverage gaps stay open.
omittedResponsibilities: This local language binding preserves existing JS string API signatures, not original native method signatures; original native methods are separately implemented and invoked without an alternate encoder.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Explicit existing JS package string I/O binding over genuine source stream/context/sequence owners. This platform-neutral language binding contains no DOM, browser API or service-provider implementation; native source signatures remain separately implemented.
